items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: So Red Happy, we all was in the same class... So I'll give you my snare drum and I took the bass drum... That's where Red took the snare, took the bass drum.

ctx.x: I was going to ask some more about those early days. Some of the, when you first played in a brass band, did you play snare drum or bass drum most of the time? Snare drum.

Snare drum. I never beat a bass drum. Never did beat the bass drum. There was one time I was playing a, I was playing a parade and one of our great bass drum players, very few people know it, there was Old Man Robichaud, a violin player? Oh yes, I heard he played. Old Man Robichaud, a wonderful bass player. Old Man Robichaud was a wonderful bass player, but strictly by music. All the fumes and everything, he used to play all of that. So he taken sick. And they had Red Happy around at that time. And he called Red…
Who all was in the Excelsior band? Who was the leader?
